explanations.2: This checks if the requested file path is a directory (-d); the [OR] means the next condition will also be checked even if this one is true.
explanations.3: This checks if the requested file path is a regular file (-f), and if either this or the previous condition is true, the rule below will apply.
explanations.4: This blocks (denies with F flag) any request that contains a dot at the start of a path segment, like '.htaccess' or '/.hidden', preventing access to hidden files.
